items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 14 November 2026 10:30pm
items.description:
##Today##

Cloudy with only isolated showers early tonight. Fresh to strong south or southwest winds. Comments: Strong winds.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 3°C and max. air temperature 11°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-6


##Wind Speed##

25


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

South or southwest 20-30, with gusts of 35-40.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Tomorrow##

A band of rain will arrive overnight, remaining persistent and heavy at times through the morning. This will gradually clear during the afternoon, though a few showers may linger. Fresh to strong, southwest winds will decrease for a time in the morning before veering northwest and strengthening again. Maximum temperature 10°C.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 3°C and max. air temperature 10°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

10-15


##Wind Speed##

20


##Wind Direction##

NW


##Wind##

South or southwest 20-25, decreasing 15-20 in the morning, then veering northwest 20-35 in the afternoon and evening, with gusts up to 45. Then gradually decreasing early in the night.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain. Occasional hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong winds at first and again later. Heavy rain at times.


##Monday, 16 November 2026##

Some clear intervals and a few showers overnight, which may be wintry over higher ground. Minimum temperature of -1°C on higher ground and in the central valley. Mainly dry with bright or sunny spells during the daytime, then cloud thickens through the evening with a band of rain arriving early in the night. Moderate to fresh northwest winds becoming light and variable for a time during the day, before becoming easterly in the afternoon, then increasing strong later. Top temperature of 8°C.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature -1°C and max. air temperature 8°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-6


##Wind Speed##

14


##Wind Direction##

NW


##Wind##

Northwest 15-20, decreasing west 5-10 by midday, then sharply becoming east or southeast in the afternoon. Increasing 25-30 later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.


##Comments##

Risk of frost and ice warning. Strong winds and gales later.


##Tuesday, 17 November 2026##

An area of rain arriving around midnight, perhaps turning wintry on higher ground at first, then with with rain continuing persistent and often heavy for much of the day, clearing early in the night. Strong east winds gradually easing from the northeast. Top temperature 8°C.


##Temperature##

##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor. Occasional hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong winds at first. Risk of snow on higher ground at first.


##Wednesday, 18 November 2026##

Cloudy with outbreaks of rain for much of this period. Moderate to fresh northeast winds decreasing to become light to moderate. Top temperature 9°C.
